facts.note: Dinner-end, sitting with brandy, and the watch reading of 4 minutes to ten at the temple's ten are all stated. But the sheet's 'alone' is absent: the transcript says only 'I stayed in this room with the brandy,' so the solitude is missing.
Went out into the street to smoke at 21 minutes past ten by his watch, and stayed under the front windows of the house.
Piano started in the salon just as he lit his cigar, at 29 minutes past ten by his watch; it stopped at 18 minutes to eleven by his watch.
At 26 minutes to eleven by his watch, faint quick bells from the master's window above; the piano was playing all the while.
Came back in at 14 minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he went up to Félix in the library.
